selection: Editorial synthesis from the ranked skill methods; references inspire ideas and do not establish correctness or endorsement.

opportunities.title: Task brief with first actions
opportunities.action: Reuse render_focused_task_context
opportunities.discriminating_check: Goal, inputs and acceptance remain exact after rendering.

opportunities.title: Context with complete prerequisites
opportunities.action: Reuse select_context_blocks
opportunities.discriminating_check: Mandatory dependency closure fits the declared cost allowance.

opportunities.title: Capability requirements from observed facts
opportunities.action: Reuse evaluate_capability_requirements
opportunities.discriminating_check: Unknown or insufficient evidence never satisfies a required feature.

opportunities.title: Paired engine evaluation
opportunities.action: Reuse paired_sign_test
opportunities.discriminating_check: Ties and missing measurements never become wins.

opportunities.title: Change inventory review
opportunities.action: Reuse compare_file_inventories
opportunities.discriminating_check: Distinguish bytes, modes, additions and removals without guessing renames.

opportunities.title: Prerequisite resolver
opportunities.action: Reuse resolve_selected_dependency_closure
opportunities.discriminating_check: Include every required dependency and explicitly report relevant cycles.

opportunities.title: Observed event ordering
opportunities.action: Reuse validate_event_precedence
opportunities.discriminating_check: Missing observations and wrong order are separate failures.

opportunities.title: Exact source-span edits
opportunities.action: Reuse apply_nonoverlapping_text_edits
opportunities.discriminating_check: Edits are interpreted against one frozen original string.

opportunities.title: Portable path conflict inspection
opportunities.action: Reuse detect_portable_path_collisions
opportunities.discriminating_check: Report normalized collisions without claiming filesystem containment.

opportunities.title: Guarded object update plan
opportunities.action: Reuse apply_flat_record_changes
opportunities.discriminating_check: A single expected-state conflict prevents partial application.

opportunities.title: Requirement-to-check coverage
opportunities.action: Build an original traceability report over explicit requirements and checks
opportunities.discriminating_check: No requirement is called covered merely because a similarly named check exists.

opportunities.title: Review findings with source anchors
opportunities.action: Build a bounded finding format and validate current file/span digests
opportunities.discriminating_check: An old line number cannot silently bind to new source bytes.

opportunities.title: Repeated failure classification
opportunities.action: Wrap existing failure classification into a retrieval-ready method package
opportunities.discriminating_check: Outage, invalid output, unknown effects and exhausted authority stay distinct.

opportunities.title: Browser observation handoff
opportunities.action: Package a compact typed DOM/action observation with explicit unknowns
opportunities.discriminating_check: An observed element is not evidence that a requested action succeeded.

opportunities.title: Accessibility evidence checklist
opportunities.action: Build measurable DOM checks plus an explicit manual-review remainder
opportunities.discriminating_check: Automated checks never imply complete accessibility conformance.

opportunities.title: Design token consistency
opportunities.action: Build a deterministic token-reference and undefined-variable report
opportunities.discriminating_check: Colour or spacing references must resolve in the declared theme.

opportunities.title: Research claim traceability
opportunities.action: Build a claim-to-source and observation-status contract
opportunities.discriminating_check: Inference and missing evidence remain visible beside source-backed facts.

opportunities.title: Native instruction variant comparison
opportunities.action: Wrap the compiler preview to compare required semantics across projections
opportunities.discriminating_check: Provider-specific omission of a required constraint refuses compilation.

opportunities.title: Model-specific instruction reduction
opportunities.action: Stage constrained rewrites and compare on held-out task acceptance
opportunities.discriminating_check: Shorter text is accepted only when required meaning and measured quality remain adequate.

opportunities.title: Local note-link inspection
opportunities.action: Reuse audit_wikilink_resolution from the research-inspired cohort
opportunities.discriminating_check: Missing targets, ambiguous names and unchecked fragments remain separate.
